title: The Sellswords
text: A band of sellswords lounges by the otherworld road, between contracts, scarred and patient, their gear mismatched from a dozen dead owners. They would fight beside you for a fee, they say. Or rob you for free. They have not decided which.

options.label: The Leader hires them for the next fight, before they decide on the other thing.

outcomes.text: They earn every coin, and do not ask for more. This time.

options.label: The best talker convinces them you are not worth robbing.

outcomes.text: They laugh, decide you are not, and pass by.

options.label: Strike before they decide, and let them learn the price of hesitation.

outcomes.text: They are as good as they say.
